description.value: A family-owned community institution for over 35 years, the Bowen Island Pub sits at the Four Corners intersection just 300 metres up the hill from the Snug Cove ferry terminal — making it a natural first or last stop for cyclists riding on Bowen Island. The pub offers a broad menu spanning pub classics, sushi, pizza, and a kids menu, along with a full cocktail and BC craft beer list. Live music events and a sun-drenched patio add to the appeal for anyone settling in after a day on the island's roads.
